pr_body:
# Pull Request

## Related issue
Fixes https://github.com/meilisearch/meilisearch/issues/5079
Fixes https://github.com/meilisearch/meilisearch/issues/5112

## What does this PR do?
- Make the processing tasks actually processing in the stats of the batch instead of enqueued
- Stop counting one extra task for all non-prioritized batches in the stats
- Add a test

issue_context.title: [To be checked] Current batch running sometimes accumulate its details twice instead of one time
issue_context.body:
I have a meeting and don't have the time to detail everything that happened, but that should be investigated before the end of the week.
It seems like the stats generated in a batch sometimes count the number of tasks contained twice:
I added one document in a single document addition and the stats were showing two documents addition.
